items.title: Govern and discover records with common metadata in AWS Agent Registry
items.summary: Custom metadata schemas in AWS Agent Registry let an administrator define typed, validated fields that every agent, MCP server, and skill must carry. This post follows an MCP record from schema definition through registration, enrichment, approval, and discovery, so teams govern and find resources with one shared set of facts.
items.creator: Sana Iqbal

items.title: Secure OAuth patterns for Snowflake Cortex AI through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: When an AI agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore calls Snowflake Cortex AI over MCP, how does it authenticate? This post walks through three OAuth patterns we tested on AgentCore Identity: Snowflake OAuth, three-legged OAuth with a corporate IdP, and two-legged OAuth, so you can match your organization's identity, audit, and compliance needs.
items.creator: Nithyashree Alwarsamy
